texts: The village square sits between the harbor and the Watch.
A weekly market runs in the village square.
Boats from down the coast bring grain, salt, cloth, and ironmongery to the market.
The villagers use the market salt for cooking.
Imported salt does not yield mire-essence.
Mire-essence distillation requires sea-water from the local pools.

fields.sentence: The village square sits between the harbor and the Watch.

q2_gaps: 'between A and B' — an inherently two-object locative preposition: the entity-attached surface-preposition form is defined only as the binary (<Prep> <entity> <object>), so nothing licenses the ternary (Between square harbor watch) the parse used, and the licensed binary form cannot express it (two separate Between atoms would be a different claim)
review.notes: 'the Watch' is correctly treated as a capitalized common-noun label with no Name atom, the noun modifier of village_square is correctly not exposed as a genus, and 'sits' correctly mints no event. The head Between is licensed under the surface-preposition licence; only its arity is unaddressed.

fields.sentence: A weekly market runs in the village square.

q2_gaps: attributive frequency adjective inside an NP ('a weekly market') — the Frequency & habitual schedules machinery (Every / TimesPer / a named Time slot) is keyed to adverbial wording ('every week', 'twice a week'), so a noun-internal frequency adjective has no recurrence encoding and can only land as a plain property atom on the entity
review.notes: Agent on the market for 'runs' matches the instruction set's own 'The market runs from 8 am to 1 pm' example, and the event-side Location (not LocatedIn) is right because an eventuality is present; the recurrence carried by 'weekly' survives only as (Member sk_market_1 weekly).

fields.sentence: Boats from down the coast bring grain, salt, cloth, and ironmongery to the market.
parse: (: boats_bring_rule (Implication (And (Member $x boat) (From $x sk_coast_1)) (And (Member (sk_bring $x) bring) (Agent (sk_bring $x) $x) (Theme (sk_bring $x) grain) (Theme (sk_bring $x) salt) (Theme (sk_bring $x) cloth) (Theme (sk_bring $x) ironmongery) (Goal (sk_bring $x) sk_market_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The four coordinated objects are stacked as four Theme atoms on one Skolem event, whereas the instruction set makes coordinated noun phrases distributive by default — the whole predication replicated once per conjunct, one event each.

"from down the coast" is reduced to (From $x sk_coast_1), silently dropping "down" and widening the origin to the coast at large, where the multi-word-preposition convention would join the whole preposition run into one head.

q2_gaps: Distributing a coordinated direct-object list inside a generic rule's conclusion: the Skolem-function event term (sk_bring $x) yields exactly one event per binding, and the instruction set gives no licensed way to mint one event per coordinated conjunct there.
review.notes: The generic-rule route, the 0.9/0.9 bare-generic truth value, bare-kind object fillers, Goal for "to the market", and top-level typing of the premise's sk_coast_1 constant are all correct; no QuantifierPhrase companion is right for a bare generic.

issues.reason: Coordination & plurals makes coordinated noun phrases distributive by default — the whole predication replicated once per conjunct, one event each — so stacking four `Theme` atoms on one event instead states a single bringing of all four commodities together, a multi-atom-same-role shape licensed only for the collective `Agent` case.

Core patterns forbids silently dropping a stated restriction ("omitting it widens the claim") — "from down the coast" is narrower than "from the coast" — and the multi-word-preposition convention (`NextTo`, `AcrossTheLaneFrom`) licenses joining the whole surface run into one entity-attached head, so a compliant form does exist.

gaps_confirmed: Distributing a coordinated object list inside a generic rule's conclusion: `(sk_bring $x)` names exactly one event per binding, and nothing licenses a per-conjunct Skolem event function (or a per-conjunct rule split with distinct function symbols) to mint one event per coordinated object.
new_gaps: A deictically-anchored path premodifier ("down the coast", "up the river"): the CamelCase-joined head records the surface words, but a licensed form would also need to carry the reference point the direction is relative to, and there is no slot for it.
adjudication.defect_summary: For the coordinated objects the instruction set licenses no compliant form inside the rule — four events would each need their own Skolem function, which nothing provides — so the loss is filed as the gap above rather than fixed. For the preposition the compliant form is the joined surface head keeping the dropped word, `(FromDown $x sk_coast_1)`.
adjudication.notes: The generic-rule route, the 0.9/0.9 bare-generic truth value, bare-kind object fillers, `Goal` for "to the market", the absent `QuantifierPhrase`, and the top-level typing that licenses the `sk_coast_1` constant in a premise are all correct.

fields.sentence: The villagers use the market salt for cooking.

review.notes: The definite plural correctly yields a group witness with both the group event and the per-member distribution rule (1.0/0.9), and 'use' takes Theme as the role table specifies. 'for cooking' takes the preposition-named For oblique with the purpose eventuality reified but asserted nowhere, matching the 'a vehicle for V-ing' precedent.

fields.sentence: Imported salt does not yield mire-essence.

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route rather than a kind-level (Yield salt mire_essence) relation, and "imported" stays a participial adjective rather than the verb. Strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9, the absent QuantifierPhrase for plain "not", and the definitional mire_essence genus all match doctrine.

fields.sentence: Mire-essence distillation requires sea-water from the local pools.

q1_issues.issue: A bare kind-denoting mass subject with a non-modal verbal predicate is a generic, which the instruction set routes to a distributing `Implication` rule over `(Member $x mire_essence_distillation)` (or, for bare-kind-on-both-sides, an opaque kind-level relation); a single flat event witness is neither licensed form.

The bare kind symbol `mire_essence_distillation` is placed in an event `Agent` slot — the instruction set reserves the bare class symbol for non-specific/generic OBJECTS and gives no licence for a kind as an event subject filler.

The event class and role atoms carry confidence 0.9, but the empirical dial applies to generalizations (rules / kind-level `Inheritance`); asserted event class and role atoms take the default (STV 1.0 0.99).

review.notes: The definite plural "the local pools" is handled correctly — group witness plus the per-member distribution rule for the descriptive modifier — and entity-attached `From` for the origin PP plus the `sea_water`/`mire_essence_distillation` genus atoms are all licensed. Minor mechanical slip: the witness `sk_seawater_1` is not minted from its class symbol `sea_water`.

issues.reason: Quantifiers, generics & scope states that a verbal generic over a kind becomes a distributing Implication rule, and the flat event compounds the error by asserting at top level that one particular quantity of sea-water from the local pools exists (Member sk_seawater_1 sea_water / From ...), which a requirement-claim never states.

The bare class symbol is reserved by Existential for non-specific/generic OBJECTS, and nothing licenses a kind in an event role slot — putting mire_essence_distillation in Agent conflates class with individual, the same discipline that bars an individual from a class position.

The half that stands is the rule cited — the dial is generalization-only, so a flat asserted event/role atom must take the default 0.99; it is overstated in implying the fix is to raise these, since under the licensed distributing-rule form the empirical (STV 0.9 0.9) is exactly the right truth value.

new_gaps: An intensional object of require / need / want is asserted to exist by the ordinary Theme-plus-witness route: "requires sea-water" states a requirement, not that any sea-water exists, yet the event route (which the instruction set explicitly prescribes for "a winch needs an annual inspection") emits (Member <witness> sea_water) at top level — the nominal side has the "asserted nowhere" (For <noun> <argument>) oblique, and the verbal side has no counterpart.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form is the distributing rule (Implication (Member $x mire_essence_distillation) (And (Member (sk_require $x) require) (Agent (sk_require $x) $x) (Theme (sk_require $x) (sk_sea_water $x)) (Member (sk_sea_water $x) sea_water) (From (sk_sea_water $x) sk_pools_1))) at (STV 0.9 0.9), with the genus, the pools group and its local-modifier rule staying top-level; issue 1's compliant form falls out of the same rewrite — the kind symbol appears only as the rule's premise domain and the Agent slot takes the bound $x, never the kind itself.
adjudication.notes: Issues 0 and 1 are two views of one defect, so a single re-parse settles both; the reviewer's parenthetical kind-relation alternative does not in fact apply, since "sea-water from the local pools" carries a definite restrictor and so is not a bare kind NP. One mechanical slip the reviewer left in notes is worth carrying forward: the witness is sk_seawater_1 where the class symbol is sea_water, and witnesses are minted from the class.
